BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Tell me a story about Harriet Tubman, a real story ASSISTANT:

Harriet Tubman was born into the slave family of a Maryland plantation in 1822. When she was a young girl, she was able to escape her master and make her way to the northern free states. She risked her life many times to help other slaves escape and reach freedom. She became an icon of courage and bravery, and was known as the 'Moses of her people' for her role in leading slaves to freedom during the abolition of the slave trade
